race.comment: NATURE'S RECKONING (5) has the most persuasive recent profile after going under by just under a length at this track and coming through a competitive Northam run where she was also close up despite covering ground. She is proven around 1400m and she can land the knockout blow. COSMIC TREAT (11) is the key danger, with her Ascot seventh forgivable after racing wide throughout in Saturday company, and her Northam fourth behind ELEGANT RULER reads well for this. ELEGANT RULER (7) beat both COSMIC TREAT and NATURE'S RECKONING at Northam before finding a 1 Metro Win at Ascot too sharp, and the easier assignment plus first-time blinkers give her a genuine winning case. FEARLESS TALK (12) had little room straightening when beaten a length and a half at Belmont, and her established 1400m record keeps her in the mix if she sharpens third-up. GOLDEN DORE (1) not to be discounted despite an average first-up run.
